label: Steve Gaines

won.source: The promotion's own 2 August 1999 broadcast: the referee's contested decision names Steve Gaines the new champion after a disputed near-fall.

note: Still billed champion as of the promotion's own last document held in this record, 2 August 1999.

title: gcw-georgia-1998-glory
